description: Wire all new pages into the application shell: update App.jsx to add the 4 new routes and replace the archives route, update DashboardLayout.jsx to expand the sidebar menu with role-based conditional items and a dynamic user label. Depends on FEAT-001 having created the new page files.
steps: Step 1 — Update c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\App.jsx. Read the file first. Add 4 import lines after the existing page imports: import QuizManager from './pages/QuizManager'; import ContentManager from './pages/ContentManager'; import ArchivesAdmin from './pages/ArchivesAdmin'; import AdminDashboard from './pages/AdminDashboard'; Remove the `import Archives from './pages/Archives';` line. Inside the Routes block: replace the existing archives route element from Archives to ArchivesAdmin — change `<Archives />` to `<ArchivesAdmin />`. Add 3 new Route elements (place them just before the legacyPaths map): <Route path='/quiz' element={<ProtectedRoute><QuizManager /></ProtectedRoute>} /> and <Route path='/contents' element={<ProtectedRoute><ContentManager /></ProtectedRoute>} /> and <Route path='/admin' element={<ProtectedRoute><AdminDashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />. Keep all other routes and the legacyPaths block exactly as is.

Step 2 — Update c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\components\DashboardLayout.jsx. Read the file first. Remove the static const menuItems = [...] array defined at module level (lines before the function). Inside the DashboardLayout function, after the line `const { user, logout } = useAuth();` (which is already there), add the dynamic menu construction: const baseItems = [ { path: '/dashboard', page: 'dashboard', icon: '▣', label: 'Tableau de bord' }, { path: '/ai', page: 'ai', icon: '✨', label: 'Assistant IA' }, { path: '/quiz', page: 'quiz', icon: '☑', label: 'Mes Quiz' }, { path: '/contents', page: 'contents', icon: '📚', label: 'Mes Contenus' }, { path: '/archives', page: 'archives', icon: '▧', label: 'Archives' }, ]; const adminItem = { path: '/admin', page: 'admin', icon: '⚙', label: 'Administration' }; const menuItems = user?.role === 'administrateur' ? [...baseItems, adminItem] : baseItems; In the topbar user info section, find the hardcoded string 'ESPACE ENSEIGNANT' and replace it with: {user?.role === 'administrateur' ? 'ADMINISTRATEUR' : 'ESPACE ENSEIGNANT'} — the outer JSX span already exists, just change the inner text content.
acceptance_criteria: App.jsx compiles without errors, /quiz /contents /archives /admin routes all render their corresponding page components when navigated to
DashboardLayout sidebar shows 5 menu items for regular users (dashboard, ai, quiz, contents, archives) and 6 items for admin (+ administration)
Topbar label shows ADMINISTRATEUR for admin role and ESPACE ENSEIGNANT otherwise
npm run build passes with exit code 0
